text: Understood, and now written at the TOP of the repo's CLAUDE.md and the routine instructions in your own words, so every account's session reads it first: study the engine, PropLine history, all scanned/saved bets and the engine's bids and fills, and change filters, settings, bet/bid kinds and amounts myself when the evidence supports it, without asking you.
